tagline: Edisto's last three miles, along the beach to the marina.
intro: Where the national byway across Edisto Island stops at the state park, SC 174 goes on into the town of Edisto Beach, the only road in. The scenic highway's three miles take in the beachfront along Palmetto Boulevard and end at the marina on Big Bay Creek.

It was not always so easy. When people first came out in the 1920s to build rough retreats, the island could be reached only at low tide, by driving or riding across the marsh on beds of oyster shells.

moments.title: Edisto Beach State Park
moments.text: One of the state's first parks, built by the Civilian Conservation Corps, where trails through the maritime forest lead to a shell midden dated to 2000 BC.

moments.title: Edisto Beach
moments.text: A town of about a thousand at the southeastern tip of Colleton County, cut off from the rest of its own county by the South Edisto River and reached only through Charleston County.
